title: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on Night Ride | 1968
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono made a late night appearance on BBC Radio 1’s Night Ride on 12 December 1968.

The show was presented by John Peel, and broadcast live from BBC Broadcasting House from 00:05 to 2am.

Lennon and Ono were interviewed during the first half of the show, after which they returned to InterTel in Wembley, London, where The Rolling Stones were filming their television spectacular Rock And Roll Circus.
